rows.ARS:
Medium red Polyantha.
Registration name: Orange Triumph
Exhibition name: Orange Triumph
rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm J.H. Kordes II (1891-1976) (Germany, before 1936).
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1939 as 'Orange Triumph'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red. Salmon red. Reddish salmon. Scarlet orange. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 1.5". Small, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact, upright. Glossy foliage.

Height: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Rain tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.

colour: Orange-red. Salmon red. Reddish salmon. Scarlet orange.
